concerns.text: FR-004 and SC-005 require held-out test instances distinct from training data. Task T013 (Implement held-out test instance generator) is marked as incomplete (unchecked). Without this task, the system cannot generate the `data/test_instances.json` required for FR-004 (evaluation against held-out sets) and FR-005 (calculating forgetting rate). This is a missing task for a core functional requirement.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and FR-001 require datasets to be checksummed and recorded. Task T014 (Implement data writing logic... with checksums) is marked as incomplete (unchecked). Without this, the project cannot satisfy the non-negotiable reproducibility requirement before training begins.

SC-005 requires a validity gate (≥99% valid proofs/grids). Task T015 (Implement validation script) is marked as incomplete (unchecked). The spec requires this gate to prevent training on invalid data. Missing this task leaves the system without a mechanism to enforce SC-005.

SC-004 requires a minimum sample size of N ≥ 30 runs per condition to achieve statistical power. Task T042 (Implement 'Pilot Power Estimation') is marked as incomplete (unchecked). While the spec defers exact counts, the mechanism to determine the seed list for the batch runner (T029) is missing. Without T042, T029 cannot generate the required `data/batch_config.json` with the correct number of seeds, blocking the execution of the statistical power requirement.

FR-005 requires calculating the forgetting rate from initial to final performance. Task T026 (Implement evaluation logic) is marked as incomplete (unchecked). This task is the core implementation of the dependent variable measurement. Its absence means the system cannot calculate the primary metric required by the research question.

SC-004 requires N ≥ 30 runs per condition. Task T029 (Implement batch runner) is marked as incomplete (unchecked). This task is responsible for executing the multiple runs required to meet the statistical power constraint. Without it, the study cannot be conducted.

FR-002 requires a post-run checksum verification of rule evaluations. Tasks T041 (Post-Run Parity Verification Report), T043 (Post-Run Checksum Artifact Generator), and T049 (Parity Validation Gate) are all marked as incomplete (unchecked). These tasks are essential to satisfy the 'verified by post-run checksum' clause of FR-002. Missing them leaves the parity constraint unverified.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires results to be reproducible. Task T045 (Implement 'Reproducibility Audit Script') is marked as incomplete (unchecked). This task is the explicit implementation of the reproducibility verification step required by the constitution.

The plan requires strict data flow ordering to prevent 'verify before generate' failures. Task T050 (Implement 'Data Flow Dependency Validator') is marked as incomplete (unchecked). Without this, the system lacks the mechanism to enforce the ordering constraints described in the plan and spec edge cases.

Task T042 description states: 'Do NOT depend on T028; perform the pilot run directly using T023.' However, the task is marked incomplete. The description implies a specific logic (pilot run) that contradicts the spec's fixed N≥30 requirement if interpreted as a dynamic calculation. The task needs to be completed to clarify if it generates the fixed N=30 seeds or calculates a dynamic N. As it stands, the incomplete status blocks the seed generation for T029.
